SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9.0/5.0 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f 
FROM pier 
WHERE ts_season = 2 
ORDER BY ts_t DESC 
LIMIT 10

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(AVG(CAST(yt as FLOAT) / (anglers + 0.5)), 3) as avg_yt_per_share, SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 240
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
LIMIT 50

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT boat, ', ') as boat_list
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy IN (273, 280, 287, 294)
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
